cb_unify_ilkahante = {

	create_visible = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		exists = international_organization:ilkhanate
		has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
			type = special_status:ilkhan_claimant
			international_organization = international_organization:ilkhanate
		}
		scope:target = {
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:ilkhanate
		}
	}
	declare_enabled = {
		exists = international_organization:ilkhanate
		has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
			type = special_status:ilkhan_claimant
			international_organization = international_organization:ilkhanate
		}
		scope:target = {
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:ilkhanate
		}
	}

	speed = 10

	war_goal_type = unify_ilkhanate_wargoal
}
